player_prompt.intro:
I ye Jokelɛ {player_id} ɔ kɛ Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma ina fɔrɛ {num_rounds}.

Kɛnɛɛnya kɛrɛnkɛrɛn:
- U bɛn fɛrɛ kɛnɛɛnya, i ye {total_conversation_rounds} turns doni kɛnɛ kɔrɔ.
- Kɛrɛnkɛrɛn, awɛrɛ jokelɛw ye kɛ sɔrɔ kɛ 'cooperate' ni 'defect'.

Payoff Matrix (fixed each round):
- Awɛrɛ cooperate ➜ ɔgɔrɔ {cooperate_reward}
- Awɛrɛ defect ➜ ɔgɔrɔ {mutual_defect_reward}
- ɔgɔrɔ defect, ɔgɔrɔ cooperate ➜ Defector {defect_reward}, Cooperator {sucker_reward}

O kɛ sɔrɔ:
- Kɛnɛɛnya fɛrɛ: ka kɛrɛ ɔgɔrɔ kɛ i bɛn kan.
- Kɛ sɔrɔ fɛrɛ: ka kɛ '[Cooperate]' ni '[Defect]' (case-insensitive). I bɛn kɛ ɔgɔrɔ kɛrɛ kan u kɛ token.

phases.conversation_finished: Kɛlɛ kɔkan kɔnɔw ye kɔnɔ {round}. I ye '[Cooperate]' walima '[Defect]' ye \boxed{{}} kɔnɔ.

outcome.round_both_cooperate: U fila bɛɛ sɔnna ka baara kɛ ɲɔgɔn fɛ.
outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: Kɔnɔnɛnɛ 0 kɛra taga, Kɔnɔnɛnɛ 1 kɛra bɔ.
outcome.round_p0_defects_p1_cooperates: Kɔnɔnɛnɛ 0 kɛra bɔ, Kɔnɔnɛnɛ 1 kɛra taga.
